name: Cable Deadlift
steps: Face the low pulley and take an overhand grip on its bar.
Step back to take up the slack, then bend your hips and knees with the bar in front of your shins.
Brace your trunk and drive through your feet to stand tall, keeping the bar close to your thighs.
Push your hips back and bend your knees under control to lower the bar toward the pulley.
tips: Move your shoulders and hips together as you stand.
Keep your spine neutral and avoid rounding your lower back during the hinge.
